note: Preview gallery for ui_gallery: every layout of the PDA as the engine draws it. Page hosts are the container a layout lives in (layout units); migrated rows use the list width minus 10 (the scrollbar). A fixture travels to the bridge as one JSON string of at most ~1000 bytes on the wire. `oz_pda_hud_proxy.layout` joined the gallery on 2026-09-06 (`hud-proxy`): it was the one layout kept out, because its `ProxyLabel` was exact-positioned 8 units in with a width that is a fraction of its parent and so overflowed that parent by 8 units at any host size a preview could give it (issues.error == 1, independent of the rect). The inset is now a fraction of the frame too, the label fits at every size, and the entry is clean.

entries.name: shell
entries.note: the device shell with seven tabs in the rail; pages are looked at separately

entries.name: page-map
entries.note: the marker panel open, six rows in it; the fixture hides the map itself, because a MapWidget paints over every neighbour and the panel would be under it in a still. The first row is the worst case the server can send: a name at the 32-byte cap, the tracked marker's coordinates with a distance, and a description already cut to the 64 bytes RebuildRows leaves it

entries.name: page-contacts
entries.note: Half-width page; the faction page is its satellite. Four rows as OZ_PdaPageContacts.Row() builds them: a name, the longest faction name of the registry, and one of the four marks Where() can put in RowWhere -- each written as its stringtable key alone, because the engine translates a string that BEGINS with a key. A language round then renders all four, and this is the only still where the mark column can be measured against the faction column beside it. The fixture carries no note of its own: it travels to the bridge as ONE JSON string, ReadFromString truncates above 1023 bytes, and these thirteen ops already weigh 939.

entries.name: page-chat
entries.note: rows come from the fixture the way the script adds them; heights are the engine's

entries.name: row-contact
entries.note: the three labels of line one share 590 units: the name, the faction in its own colour, and the right-anchored Where() line that grows leftwards -- the fixture is the widest each of them gets

entries.name: row-marker
entries.note: 303 = the map page's MarkerScroll (313) minus the scrollbar; the panel is 325 wide, so the row is what a 32-byte name and a 160-byte description have to live in

entries.name: hud-proxy
entries.note: the draggable frame OZ_HudEditMenu puts over every HUD panel, sized here by its own declaration (`size 0.1 0.05`) against the whole screen, like the two `hud` entries above it. NO host on purpose: the frame's size is a FRACTION, so a host is what it is a fraction OF -- a host of 384x84 units drew the frame 38x4 px and its caption could not fit in that (measured 2026-09-06). In the editor the script overrides the size from the live panel anyway; what a still can show is that the caption sits inside the frame with an inset at whatever size it is given

entries.name: vpp-pane
entries.note: generated from ui/OpenZone_PDA_VPP/oz_pda_vpp_pane.json. The host stays the whole admin window (1000x620), not the pane rectangle, so the pane sits at [0, 96] exactly where the core's own panes sit. The fixture shows the root (the layout is hidden -- the core's ShowPane opens it) and types numbers into the tuning form. Three of the seventeen tuning fields stay empty and the hardware form carries one value: all seventeen plus the show op serialise to 1143 bytes and the engine truncates a fixture JSON string above 1023, so the budget holds fourteen of them plus one Hw field at 998 bytes. HwList is empty in every still: rows of a TextListboxWidget arrive through AddItem, out of reach of add/text/show/hide/color. PdaProfBox is hidden here, as it is on the first show of the real pane

entries.name: vpp-pane-prof
entries.note: the same layout as vpp-pane, a second entry over it -- nothing requires layout to be unique and entries are otherwise independent. PdaHwBox and PdaProfBox are mutually hidden mini-tabs (OnClick shows one, hides the other) and the gallery's checker only looks at shown nodes, so vpp-pane alone never draws PdaProfBox, ProfBody, PdaProfEdit, ProfActions, BtnProfReload or BtnProfApply. This entry hides PdaHwBox, shows PdaProfBox, and fills PdaProfEdit with a short Profiles.json excerpt; the spare byte budget (no hardware form to fill) also buys back the three tuning fields vpp-pane's own fixture left blank at its 1000-byte ceiling -- Tun_MarkerDescMaxBytes, Tun_SwapOfferTtlSeconds, Tun_RouteAdvanceMeters -- so all seventeen are shown across the two entries together

entries.name: icons
entries.note: every sprite of the set, tinted accent; blank cells = the set is not registered or the texture did not load
